title: Pocketwire Business Subscription Volume Relief Bands
content:
The monthly subscription of the Pocketwire Business Profile carries a volume relief percentage set by the subscription relief volume, measured against the waiver volume of the tier.

**Subscription relief net sales.** The subscription relief net sales are the sales less the refunds less the chargebacks on the profile dated within the rolling month ending on the handling date. A rolling window of a number of months ending on the handling date covers the dates after the same calendar day that many months earlier, up to and including the handling date. For a handling date of 1 May, the rolling month covers 2 April up to and including 1 May.

**Bands.** A subscription relief volume at or above 80 percent (0.8) of the tier's waiver volume earns a volume relief percentage of 30 percent; a subscription relief volume below that but at or above 50 percent (0.5) of it earns 15 percent; a lower subscription relief volume earns no volume relief percentage.

## Band thresholds in figures

| Tier | Waiver volume | 30 percent band from | 15 percent band from | No relief below |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Business Pro | USD 75000.00 | USD 60000.00 | USD 37500.00 | USD 37500.00 |
| Pocketwire Business Premier | USD 150000.00 | USD 120000.00 | USD 75000.00 | USD 75000.00 |
| Pocketwire Business Enterprise | USD 400000.00 | USD 320000.00 | USD 200000.00 | USD 200000.00 |

Pocketwire Business Starter, Pocketwire Business Essentials and Pocketwire Business Growth have a waiver volume of USD 0.00 and no subscription fee.

## Boundary pairs (Pocketwire Business Pro)

| Subscription relief volume | Volume relief percentage |
|---|---|
| USD 60000.00 | 30 percent |
| USD 59999.99 | 15 percent |
| USD 37500.00 | 15 percent |
| USD 37499.99 | none |
